status: 119 functions reviewed; 14 definitions refined; one grouped build passes all 15,169 fixed slots.

source_reviews.name: card_brutal_hordechief
source_reviews.reason: Native 0x2628309/0x2628329 call store_attackers/dat_ability before accepted-GAA instance queries at 0x2628355/0x262837f. Remove unconditional pre-trigger getter and query only on CAN/ACT/RESOLVE/CLEANUP. DAT life effects and activation costs/parent fields retain their ordering.

source_reviews.name: card_star_compass
source_reviews.reason: Native 0x218d09e/0x218d0c7 and change-type path 0x218d10f/0x218d121 perform a second instance query when the first mana_color is nonzero. Restore that conditional query instead of folding both reads through the saved pointer. Existing per-land ID query and zero-mana behavior stay intact.

source_reviews.name: card_elite_scaleguard
source_reviews.reason: Native target constructor 0x26243e9 precedes the sole DAT instance query 0x2624408 and info_slot load 0x262440f. Remove extra pre-constructor getter/count snapshot; derive the loop count from the post-constructor instance. Per-iteration can_target and fresh selected target fields remain.

source_reviews.name: card_unsubstantiate
source_reviews.reason: Make native left-before-right callback sequencing explicit: counterspell_validate returns before fresh info_slot==67 and valid_target. Both native 0x2479021/0x2479033 and pre-edit current code already implement this sequence. This removes unspecified bitwise-operand evaluation ordering without claiming an existing compiled bug.

source_reviews.name: scrylike_effect
source_reviews.reason: Explicitly finish count_deck before reading the chosen IID from the saved deck pointer. Native 0x26542b2 precedes selected load 0x26542c3; current pre-edit instructions already do so. Preserve saved deck pointer, repeated initial counts, mutable test.qty and human/AI decisions.

source_reviews.name: card_whir_of_invention
source_reviews.reason: Reconstruct common generic-spell continuation. Only CAN, affected CAST and CHANGE_TARGET run improvise before it; RESOLVE and CAN_CHANGE_TARGET skip improvise. Other events return improvise. Keep both instance queries around formatting and the post-kill generic call.

source_reviews.name: card_guiding_voice
source_reviews.reason: Consolidate repeated pump fallbacks while retaining target constructor/getter on all accepted GS events, resolution counter before learn, and fallback even for other events/unaffected casts.

source_reviews.name: card_defy_death
source_reviews.reason: Flatten human/AI/Angel branches into one existing generic-spell continuation. AI alone sets Angel and conditionally reinitializes the test; reanimation/kill still precede resolution fallback. Keep affected-cast recheck after initial constructor.

source_reviews.name: card_allosaurus_shepherd
source_reviews.reason: Replace decompiler nested while/do scan and repeated GAA exit with forward for loop and common return. Preserve original unsigned event-range predicate, no added in_play check, is_what-before-subtype order and fresh active_cards_count after every callback.

source_reviews.name: card_rhet_crop_spearmaster
source_reviews.reason: Share duh_mode/dat_ability continuation across all events, keeping affected CHECK_ABILITIES updates before duh_mode. Distinguish exertion and pump handles; preserve nonzero alternate_legacy_text gate and all callback order.

source_reviews.name: card_dauntless_dourbark
source_reviews.reason: Restore named sum/other-Treefolk roles and a normal forward scan. Preserve unsigned characteristic-event range, player==-1 guard, live scan bound and sequential Treefolk then Forest queries. Empty battlefield still sets characteristic PT to zero; abilities only adds trample.

source_reviews.name: card_twitch
source_reviews.reason: Consolidate target setup and generic-spell returns, including generic after resolution kill. Keep post-generic affected-cast recheck before AI twiddle adjustment; resolution validates, twiddles and draws in order.

source_reviews.name: card_sorcerous_sight
source_reviews.reason: Reconstruct common target setup/getter and generic-spell continuation. Preserve accepted-event guard, second affected-cast check before AI adjustment, reveal before draw and generic after resolution kill.

source_reviews.name: card_plague_boiler
source_reviews.reason: Express upkeep/static/activation counter branches directly and share the GAA continuation. Static sacrifice precedes nonland sweep, zero counters bypass chooser and add, and every nonzero chooser result removes as native.
